philosophy.heading: A substance that causes symptoms, in minute doses, can help resolve those same symptoms.
philosophy.paragraph1: Homeopathy treats each person as a unique individual, aiming to stimulate the body's own natural healing ability. The right remedy is chosen by matching the whole pattern of a person's symptoms — physical, emotional, and lifestyle — not just a diagnosis.
philosophy.paragraph2: Chopping an onion causes watery eyes and a runny nose. In homeopathy, a preparation made from onion (Allium cepa) may be chosen for someone whose symptoms closely resemble that same pattern. It's medicine built on the principle of similarity.
philosophy.quote: In every drop, a dose of nature's wisdom. In every remedy, the promise of gentle healing.
